title: Review: RocksDB block store backend
notes:
Maintainer risk: LOW — implementation is straightforward, well-tested, follows established patterns; one correctness bug in error message encoding.
Confidence: 90% chance of no missed logic bug. Uncertainty driven by: cannot test against a live RocksDB with actual compaction/tombstone behavior in CI, and the JoinError panic-to-error mapping is untested. Would raise confidence with: integration test that opens DB, inserts 1000 blocks, deletes 500, force-triggers compaction, and verifies the 500 are gone.
